COD.rationale: Content (red positions), its organization (coordinate set) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Text explicitly identifies represented content (red) and its attribute as a coordinate set.

D.rationale: An origin/status JSON block is presented separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing content identity from its status/origin.

O.rationale: The coordinate set explicitly states how the content is organized/presented (as positions).
